subject.title: [Security] Telegram Bot Token Leak in Diagnostic Timeout Logs

question: Should this report be handled through the private security-advisory path while maintainers verify whether released diagnostics expose live Telegram credentials?
rationale: The source path is credible and involves a reusable credential, but disclosure severity depends on the exact emitted diagnostics and shipped behavior; maintainers should control verification and disclosure handling.

options.title: Verify Privately and Patch
options.body: Move reproduction and release-impact analysis to the private security workflow, then land a tested redaction at the verified emission boundary.

options.title: Keep Public as Hardening
options.body: Keep public handling only if focused reproduction proves existing diagnostic sanitization prevents raw-token disclosure.

recommendation.title: Verify Privately and Patch
recommendation.body: Move reproduction and release-impact analysis to the private security workflow, then land a tested redaction at the verified emission boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram transport ownership and repository security-routing context make this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
